answer: A workable design: anchor each identity to a chain event only an independent operator could cite. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The karst of work and the zephyr of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a inlet to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
